items.title: 【AI轉型實例】玉山金打造AI智能徵信流程，7分鐘生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時
items.summary: 徵信調查是風險控管的核心，玉山銀行企業放款餘額超過1兆元，每年玉山法金部門都會重新審視往來企業的信用和財務狀況。不過，傳統法金徵信作業最大痛點是，資料散亂和人工作業耗時。數百名負責徵信作業的客戶關係經理（RM），一年得要撰寫四、五千份徵信報告，每月高達4成的工時都花在蒐集資料上。 玉山銀行花了一年，自行開發了「iCatcher」與智能徵信報告工具「智捷通」等多款AI工具，將授信作業流程中動輒耗費十多小時的資料蒐集及報告初稿製作工作，縮短至分鐘級，推估一年可以節省8.4萬個人時。

items.title: GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration That Builds a Workflow Per Coding Task in Copilot CLI
items.summary: We look at Project HydraFusion, GitHub's research preview that treats workflow selection as an optimization problem rather than a model picker. We break down the three execution patterns it routes between — Single, Cascade with a quality gate, and Critique with a read-only cross-family reviewer. The post GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration That Builds a Workflow Per Coding Task in Copilot CLI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 讓我們來看看 GitHub 的研究預覽專案 HydraFusion，它將工作流程選擇視為最佳化問題，而非簡單的模型選擇器。我們詳細分析了它提供的三種執行模式：單次執行、帶品質門的級聯執行以及帶有唯讀跨系列審閱者的評審執行。這篇文章《GitHub 推出 HydraFusion 專案：運行時多模型編排，可在 Copilot CLI 中為每個編碼任務建立工作流程》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop
items.summary: Nous Research has collapsed local model setup into a single click in Hermes Desktop. The app reads your hardware, fit-checks the catalog against your GPU, picks the highest-quality build that fits, downloads it, and configures llama.cpp — with a hard 4-bit floor and a 64K minimum context window. The post Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Nous Research 已將 Hermes Desktop 中的本地模型設定簡化為一鍵操作。該應用程式會讀取您的硬體訊息，將目錄中的版本與您的 GPU 進行匹配檢查，選擇最合適的高品質版本，下載該版本，並配置 llama.cpp 檔案——設定最低 4 位元色深和最小 64K 上下文視窗大小。這篇文章《Nous Research 為 Hermes Desktop 添加一鍵本地模型設定》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Seven minutes with a chatbot beat a fact sheet at reducing conspiracy beliefs in two experiments
items.summary: Researchers found that even a roughly seven-minute conversation with Google Gemini can reduce conspiracy beliefs about current crises, even when few verified facts are available. The effect beat a static fact sheet and, in follow-up surveys weeks later, carried over to beliefs about entirely different events. The article Seven minutes with a chatbot beat a fact sheet at reducing conspiracy beliefs in two experiments appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 研究人員發現，即使與 Google Gemini 進行大約七分鐘的對話，也能減少人們對當前危機的陰謀論，即便缺乏確鑿的事實依據。這種效果優於靜態的事實清單，並且在幾週後的後續調查中，這種效果也延伸到了人們對完全不同事件的看法。這篇文章《與聊天機器人進行七分鐘對話，在兩項實驗中勝過事實清單，有效減少陰謀論》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

The whistleblowers organized protests and boycotts on their own but failed because they had no way to enforce the rules. items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers
items.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers Blink and you'll miss it, but there's a familiar creature at 1m59s : Across the board, Astra has more attention to detail, better understanding of the user's prompt, and can build more sophisticated outputs. In particular, it excels at building 3D models. I've seen it make incredible renderings of gardens, shipyards, animals , cityscapes, even Dyson spheres. Astra really does believe in putting a red neckerchief on a pelican riding a bicycle. Via Hacker News comment Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , gpt-6-astra
items.summary_zh: 隆重推出開發者的 GPT-6 Astra。一眨眼你可能就錯過了，但在 1 分 59 秒處你會看到一個熟悉的身影：Astra 各方面都更加註重細節，對用戶指令的理解也更透徹，並且能夠產生更複雜的輸出。尤其值得一提的是，它擅長建造 3D 模型。我親眼見證了它如何渲染出令人驚嘆的花園、造船廠、動物、城市景觀，甚至是戴森球。 Astra 真的相信應該給騎自行車的鵜鶘戴上一條紅色領巾。來自 Hacker News 評論 標籤：ai、openai、generative-ai、llms、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、gpt-6-astra

items_ai.title: 【AI轉型實例】玉山金打造AI智能徵信流程，7分鐘生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時
items_ai.summary: 徵信調查是風險控管的核心，玉山銀行企業放款餘額超過1兆元，每年玉山法金部門都會重新審視往來企業的信用和財務狀況。不過，傳統法金徵信作業最大痛點是，資料散亂和人工作業耗時。數百名負責徵信作業的客戶關係經理（RM），一年得要撰寫四、五千份徵信報告，每月高達4成的工時都花在蒐集資料上。 玉山銀行花了一年，自行開發了「iCatcher」與智能徵信報告工具「智捷通」等多款AI工具，將授信作業流程中動輒耗費十多小時的資料蒐集及報告初稿製作工作，縮短至分鐘級，推估一年可以節省8.4萬個人時。

items_ai.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol
items_ai.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-6 Astra to Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users, with Plus users expected to follow soon. Message allowances for the standard model are roughly half of what GPT-5.6 Sol offers: Plus users get an estimated 5 to 45 messages per five hours with Astra, versus 10 to 100 with Sol. Higher-tier subscribers also get GPT-6 Astra Pro with separate weekly caps. Free and Go users don't get access. The article OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers Blink and you'll miss it, but there's a familiar creature at 1m59s : Across the board, Astra has more attention to detail, better understanding of the user's prompt, and can build more sophisticated outputs. In particular, it excels at building 3D models. I've seen it make incredible renderings of gardens, shipyards, animals , cityscapes, even Dyson spheres. Astra really does believe in putting a red neckerchief on a pelican riding a bicycle. Via Hacker News comment Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , gpt-6-astra
